failed_assertions.desc: MCP2515 INT output connects to STM32 PA3.
Anti-bypass: prevent LLM from skipping MCP2515 by wiring any STM32 SPI1 candidate pin directly to transceiver logic input.
Anti-bypass: prevent LLM from connecting any STM32 SPI1 candidate pin directly to CAN differential bus.
GND unification: all ground pins across 4 ICs share one common ground net.
3.3V domain unification: LDO output, MCU core/analog/battery supply, CAN controller VDD, and transceiver VCC share one power net.

Critical pin isolation: GND, VCC, VIN, SPI bundle lines (SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS), CAN logic (TXCAN/RXCAN), CAN differential (CANH/CANL), STM32 crystal (OSC_IN/OUT), MCP2515 crystal (OSC1/OSC2), and NRST must all be on mutually distinct nets. SPI isolation is anchored on MCP2515-side pins so it is invariant to STM32 SPI1 default/remap selection.
3.3V rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.

SPI1 legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal STM32F103 SPI1 routing bundle to MCP2515, either default pins or remapped pins. This forbids illegal mixed mappings such as PA5 for SCK together with PB5 for MOSI.
